I added `migrations/003_exports_status_default.sql`. I haven't run it. It does three things:

1. It sets `status` to `'queued'` on existing rows where it is NULL.
2. It sets the column default to `'queued'`.
3. It makes the column `NOT NULL`.

I didn't edit `001_init.sql`, because migrations are append-only and that file has already run in prod. The backfill comes first so that `SET NOT NULL` doesn't fail on the NULL rows you're already seeing.

If any code inserts into `exports` with an explicit `status: null`, it will now fail instead of silently getting NULL. I didn't search the application code for that.
